_comment: Amendments that got a recorded House vote, keyed by roll call: who offered them and what they did, from the Congress.gov API (fetch_legislation.py). 'bills' records when each bill's amendments were last checked.

2017-12.author: Messer
2017-12.purpose: requires each agency promulgating a new rule to identify and repeal or amend an existing rule or rules to completely offset any annual costs of the new rule to the United States economy.

2017-13.author: Grijalva

Also, if the rule increases carbon dioxide by a certain amount or increases the risk of certain health impacts to low-income or rural communities, then the rule would be defined as a major rule.

2017-15.author: Cicilline

2017-16.author: Conyers
2017-16.purpose: sought to exempt rules that provide for reduction in the amount of lead in public drinking water.

2017-17.author: Johnson (GA)
2017-17.purpose: sought to expand the term "special rule" to include any safety product rule governing products used or consumed by children under 2 years of age.

2017-18.author: Nadler

2017-19.author: McNerney
2017-19.purpose: sought to ensure that any rule intended to ensure the safety of natural gas or hazardous materials pipelines or prevent, mitigate, or reduce the impact of spills from such pipelines is not considered a "major rule".
